title: Rappler Live Jam: Healy After Dark
summary: Catch the 'Isip' hitmakers perform on Rappler Live Jam for the first time!

blocks.text: Catch the 'Isip' hitmakers perform on Rappler Live Jam for the first time!
MANILA, Philippines – It’s Healy After Dark’s turn to take the Rappler Live Jam stage on Thursday, September 17!

Hailing from Angeles City, Pampanga, Healy After Dark started out as the solo project of Oyo Velasco, who would make most of his music from his bedroom. The indie-alternative outfit has since expanded to a full band, with Daniel Lozano on lead guitars, Alvin Santiago on bass, and Zach Gonzales on drums.
With their dreamy sound, the quartet has come to be loved by listeners for tracks like “Ikaw,” “Isip,” and “Multo,” to name a few.
Catch Healy After Dark on Rappler Live Jam on Thursday, 8 pm, by bookmarking this page or heading to Rappler’s YouTube! – Rapppler.com
